gaps.explanation: Governmental detail holds only the Schedule of County Treasurer Activity (p13, total 210,084), which equals the 'Property taxes' row of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds - Cash Basis (p4: General 191,969 + Street 18,115 = 210,084). No other p4 fund-column rows are in detail. Adding every other non-zero revenue row per fund column (Property taxes excluded to avoid double counting): General Fund 857,529 - 191,969 = 665,560; Street Fund 225,500 - 18,115 = 207,385; Keno Fund 170,769; Debt Service Fund all zero. Added 665,560 + 207,385 + 170,769 = 1,043,714 = gap; 210,084 + 1,043,714 = 1,253,798 = statement total. The General Fund 'Sales and other taxes' cell 102,069 is added as the same two pieces the statement lines use (budget schedule p8: Sales tax 94,224 + Other state receipts 7,845 = 102,069); the Street Fund cell 20,903 = p8 Motor vehicle tax (motor vehicle tax, as the statement line).
